tools.name: vinted_sold_prices
tools.description: Confirmed sold prices for an item on Vinted in one country: number of sales, median and typical range (p25-p75), how many days items took to sell, how many sold within a week, and a few recent example sales. Returns a link to the full list of sales.

tools.name: vinted_compare_countries
tools.description: The same search across all 7 Vinted countries: how many sales each has, and the median price in EUR for the home country and the next busiest one, with the price gap. Useful for cross-border reselling. Returns a link to the full comparison.
